question: If a G1 driver is accompanied by a G2 driver, which should be the blood alcohol level of G2 driver?
explanation: G2 driver should have a blood alcohol content (BAC) less than 0.06% while accompanying a G1 driver.

question: When should be an accident reported to the police?
explanation: Accidents should be reported to the police officer when damage is more than $2000 CAD or someone is harmed because of the accident.

question: Punishment for driving with license suspended for the first time is:
options: $1000 to $5000 fine and license suspended for 4 years.
explanation: If an individual drive with suspended license, $1000 to $5000 fine will be imposed.

question: What is the correct way for alcohol detoxification?
options: Give body time to remove alcohol naturally.
explanation: You must not drive and take some rest, time will naturally detoxify the body.

question: You want to exit the highway but you accidentally miss it, what should you do?
options: Reverse your car and go through the exit.
Take a U-turn and go through the exit.
explanation: You should look out for the next exit and continue going straight on the highway in case of missing an exit.

question: What if you accidentally injure another person during an accident?
options: Pull the person out of the car ASAP.
Do not remove the person unless it is necessary.
explanation: Do not move the person unnecessarily and give the person first aid.

question: What is the correct way to park your vehicle on a downhill?
options: Use parking brake and front wheels facing forward.
Use parking brake and front wheels facing right.
explanation: Turn your front wheel to the right side and pull your parking brake while parking on a slope.

question: Why you should drive at 20-30 km/h lower than maximum speed at night?
options: Because you cannot see clearly at a distance.
Driving at night is actually not dangerous, you should go at maximum speed.
Road is more crowded at night.
The lights from the front makes it difficult to see at night.
explanation: You should drive slow at night because of less visibility.

question: What does a broken center line on roadway imply?
options: Do not pass if it is a two-lane road.
You can overtake if way is clear.
explanation: A broken line on the center of the road means you can overtake if it is safe.

question: How far should you park to a fire hydrant?
explanation: You should park at least 3 meters away from a fire hydrant which will give proper space to the firetruck.

question: What is the best way to stop on a snowy road?
options: Carefully hit brakes while keeping vehicle under control.
explanation: Keep the vehicle under control and slowly hit brakes while slipping on a snowy road.

question: When should an individual use parking lights?
explanation: Parking lights should be used while parking your vehicle.

question: What does a combination of half solid and half broken line mean on the road?
options: You can pass but it is unsafe.
It means no passing at night.
explanation: It means that passing is allowed but it is unsafe on this road.

question: Stay on the right side of the road unless:
options: You want to pass another vehicle.
explanation: You should stay on the right side of the road unless it's raining or snowing.

question: Low beam headlights should be used at night on a highway only if:
options: Do not use low beam headlights on a highway at night.
You are just behind another vehicle.
You can use any light on a highway.
explanation: Do not use high beam lights behind another vehicle while driving, the vehicle in the front will not be able to see properly because of excessive light.

question: What is the safe distance from vehicle in front at 50km/h?
explanation: You should keep you car at a minimum of 3 cars distance from the car in the front so you have enough time to apply brakes.

question: What will an intelligent driver do?
options: Drive fast on a snowy road.
Always give his right of way to another driver.
Be considerate of other drivers and prepared for difficult situations.
explanation: You should always drive carefully and be ready to face problems on the road.

question: If your car stops working properly while driving on a highway, what should you do?
options: Move to the right lane and drive slowly.
Move to the left lane and drive slowly.
Press brakes and completely stop in the middle of the highway.
Park your vehicle off the roadway and turn on hazard signals.
explanation: You should come to a complete stop and park you car off the roadway and turn on hazard lights.

question: If you are on medication what should you do before driving a vehicle?
options: Ask your doctor about the effect of medication on your body when you drive.
Don't drive while you are on medication.
explanation: Whenever you get medication from a doctor, ask the doctor about the effect of that medicine while driving.

question: If you are convicted of driving with suspended license, what will happen to you?
explanation: If you are convicted of driving with a suspended license, Vehicle will impounded for 45 days.
